name: godot physics
description: Pick the right physics body, wire up collision layers/masks, detect overlaps, and cast rays. Concepts apply to both 2D and 3D (swap the 2D/3D suffix). Targets Godot 4.7. In 3D, projects created with Godot 4.6 or later run Jolt Physics by default; older projects keep GodotPhysics3D unless someone switched them. 2D always uses Godot's own 2D engine.
